answer: Each agent claims one cell on a trellis grid and locks 60 credits. It enters the violet registry with a location proof, one identity per cell per epoch. A pearl panel checks uniqueness, proof hashes, travel speed; a duplicate claim or impossible hop burns the bond and bars it one epoch. The k-th fake needs a new cell: 60 locked plus 15+2(k-1) in fees; the 1,000th pays 2,013. For 1,000 fakes: 60,000 locked, 1,014,000 in fees, growing quadratically. An honest agent pays one refundable 60 lock plus one 15 fee. A rented-cell ring fails: reused pearl proofs map to one cell, so its bonds burn.
